Hildegard 0.1.12 is a pre-alpha. It fixes four things in 0.1.11's **Any free device** and opportunistic sharing.

## Install

- **macOS and Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh`
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.ps1 | iex`
- **Desktop app:** pick your system's download below, or from [dbaney.com/hildegard](https://dbaney.com/hildegard/).

Installed already? Hildegard updates itself, or run `hildegard update` (or `hildegard update all` for every device).

## Fixed

- A take with characters goes only to a device that also has the stills model its start frame needs, not just the
  video model.
- On a Mac, a model that's installed but can't run on its GPU no longer hides a paired device that can run it, so
  the Studio stops refusing takes that device would render.
- With a ComfyUI you started yourself (`--comfy`), opportunistic sharing no longer counts that ComfyUI as another
  program on the GPU and stops its own paired renders.
- A device on **Any free device** itself is never sent takes, so two such devices can't each wait on the other.
